errors.trigger: Profile, spec, blueprint, allowed paths, or approved commands missing
errors.diagnosis: Adoption requires a fully planned existing-project state
errors.rescue_action: List the missing items and stop without writing
errors.user_message: Adoption needs a project profile, spec, and blueprint with allowed paths first.

errors.trigger: Repository root, HEAD, or branch no longer matches the recorded baseline
errors.diagnosis: The repository moved since discovery/init; adopting now would target the wrong state
errors.rescue_action: Halt and report the exact drift; never adopt against a moved baseline
errors.user_message: Repository baseline drifted since discovery. Re-run discovery before adopting.

errors.trigger: Dirty worktree without a recorded human decision
errors.diagnosis: Uncommitted developer work could be disturbed by write-mode adoption
errors.rescue_action: Halt and require an explicit human decision (commit, stash, or proceed)
errors.user_message: Worktree has uncommitted changes. Decide how to handle them before adoption.

errors.trigger: Candidate run object fails schema validation
errors.diagnosis: Run update violates the run-object schema or gate contract
errors.rescue_action: Show validator output and do not write
errors.user_message: Run update failed validation. See validator output; nothing was written.
